Description: Arrange barista bar or urn pickup. Regular and decaf tea options creamers sugar alternatives

Description: Per-day blocks (breakfast coffee snacks all-day beverages) plus a who's-getting-what shopping tab with an owner per item

Description: Ensure vegetarian vegan gluten-free nut-free dairy-free options. Plan allergen labeling strategy

Description: Site visit top options to evaluate space and experience

Description: Choose appetizers vs buffet drink options (hosted bar drink tickets cash bar) and dietary options
